sections.content: Health communication at B1 involves more than giving isolated recommendations. A speaker may describe a state, explain a habit, give advice, justify it with a reason and mention a practical consequence. Combining these structures produces clearer and more useful explanations.

items.spanish: Si te sientes cansado con frecuencia, conviene que revises tus hábitos de sueño.
items.english: If you often feel tired, it is advisable that you review your sleep habits.

items.spanish: Suelo caminar todos los días porque así me siento con más energía.
items.english: I usually walk every day because that way I feel more energetic.

items.spanish: Se recomienda descansar bien, ya que la falta de sueño puede afectar al bienestar.
items.english: It is recommended to rest well, since lack of sleep can affect wellbeing.

items.spanish: Para recuperarse mejor, es importante que la rutina sea equilibrada.
items.english: To recover better, it is important that the routine be balanced.

sections.content: A useful B1 pattern is state or problem → explanation → advice → reason or consequence. This lets you communicate health information as connected discourse.
